text:
pat: Quick follow-up from the kv-cache OOM postmortem. Goal: assign owners for short mitigations (48h) and long-term actions. Reply with owner + ETA.
rachel: I'll take repro and traces on staging. Will run a 6h peak with alloc-sample=1% and upload to s3.
mike: I'll own the slab/G C tuning on canary. Plan: bump frag_threshold -> 0.48 for 48h, enable compact-window=30s for heavy shards, watch p99.
ops-bot: runbook link: infra/runbooks/kv-oom-shortmit.md
pat: repro command (staging):
```bash
TRACE_DIR=/tmp/kvtraces
./kv_repro --pool=staging --clients=120 --skew=0.85 --duration=21600 --alloc-sample=1% --out=$TRACE_DIR/pm-2425012345.tgz
```
rachel: uploading to s3://redwood-inference-dev/kv-traces/2425012345/ when done. ETA 8h.
mike: canary plan: start 2026-04-20T03:00Z, rollback on OOM or p99_read_latency > 1.8x. I'll add dashboard panels for residency, eviction_rate, frag.
pat: ops tasks: tenant soft-multiplier 0.9x for tenants >95th percentile for 48h (opt-out), and alert: residency-delta >18% sustained 10m -> page oncall.
ops-bot: ticket OPS-7001 created for residency alert (assignee: ops).
pat: ownership recap: repro/traces=rachel (ETA 8h); canary GC tuning=mike (start 2026-04-20); tenant guardrail+alert=ops (ETA 12h); retro writeup=pat (ETA 2026-04-24). Reconvene in 48h with metrics. If any canary OOM, page #eng-oncall immediately. :thumbsup:
